# acme-freight brief

Acme Freight is a small, fictional freight forwarder. Staff want a quote calculator. Synthetic: a fictional company.

## Quote
A quote takes a weight in kilograms and a zone (A, B or remote) and answers a price.

## Tiers
Prices follow the weight tariff in tariff.md.

## Remote
Shipments to the remote zone carry a surcharge.

## Rounding
Prices are rounded.

## Notes
Dangerous goods go through ops.
